## Maskinganna (CR 1)

This muscular beast-man has ruddy fur and back-bending legs ending in hooves. Its hands are humanoid and its face resembles a goat or kudu, with long, spiraling black horns.  

**XP** 400  
CN Medium fey (shapechanger)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 21 (3d6+3)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +6, **Will** +4  
**DR** 2/cold iron; **Immune** sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** shortsword +1 (1d6), gore –3 (1d6) or gore +1 (1d6)  
**Ranged** sling +4 (1d3 plus sleep)  
**Special Attacks** phantasm), powerful charge (gore, 2d6), sleep  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 16, **Con** 12, **Int** 15, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +1; **CMD** 13  
**Feats** Point-Blank Shot, Weapon Focus (sling)  
**Skills** Acrobatics +9, Bluff +8, Climb +6, Fly +9, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +9, Survival +4, Swim +6  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan  
**SQ** dream seer, change shape (Medium or smaller humanoid or forest animal, alter self or beast shape I)  


**Special Abilities**



**Dream Seer (Su)** A maskinganna can see the dreams of any sleeping creature within 10 feet. If, within the last 24 hours, the maskinganna has observed a creature’s dreams for 10 minutes then it adds a +4 insight bonus to Bluff checks and a +2 to the Phantasms DC against that creature. With a hour viewing, the maskinganna gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + 1 per creature viewed.  

**Phantasm (Su)** A maskinganna creates a vision of a nightmarish creature in the minds of creatures within 15 feet, causing them to become frightened for 1 round (DC 12 Will negates). This is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Sleep (Su)** A creature struck by a rock from a maskinganna’s sling falls magically asleep (DC 13 Will negates) for 3 minutes or until wounded or an ally uses the aid another action to awaken them. A creature that successfully saves is not subject to the same maskinganna’s sleep again for 24 hours The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any forest  
**Organization** solitary, pair, sleepover (3-6), or party (7-25 total fey)  
**Treasure** standard (sling, shortsword, other treasure)
